name: Mobocertinib

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

examples.title: (Concerto) Study of BLU-451 in Advanced Cancers With EGFR Exon 20 Insertion Mutations
examples.why: Sponsor decision, not related to safety concerns

summary: In the United States, mobocertinib has a boxed warning, which is a serious safety alert, regarding potential heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated risk scores for the drug's effects on organs [M]. This computer model gave mobocertinib a high score of 72 for liver risk and a low score of 46 for heart risk [M].
